tagline: Through sport, we have the power to change lives
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects key operational performance in a restructuring context, with a contraction of 170 bps to 1.3% in 2023 despite gross margin stability.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total company sales for the year, at constant exchange rates.
kpis.description: Net sales declined by 5% at constant exchange rates, impacted by lower sales across several regions.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved slightly due to better cost management and favorable product mix.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by net sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin fell by 170 bps, affected by exceptional charges and weak demand in China.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: Capex decreased to EUR 504 million, reflecting increased budgetary discipline.

kpis.name: Average Operating Working Capital as % of Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Level of operating working capital relative to sales.
kpis.description: Working capital increased as a percentage of sales, due to slower inventory reduction compared to sales decline.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group at year-end.
kpis.description: Headcount remained stable at approximately 59,030 employees, following prior reductions.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 20.26 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of EUR 5.56 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on key partnerships (e.g. Yeezy)
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted centrally in the report, with strong language ("handling of the existing Yeezy inventory", "legal dispute with Kanye West"). The trend is upward due to major operational and financial impact. The Competition category is critical for brand positioning.

risks.title: Inventory management and overstock
risks.score_rationale: The topic is repeated multiple times in the document ("reduction of elevated inventory levels"), with concerned language. The trend is stable, reflecting a structural challenge. The Industrial category is central to operational efficiency.

risks.title: Declining performance in North America
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited as a major factor deviating from plans. The language is alarming ("negative business development"). The trend is upward. The Geopolitical category includes strategic market dynamics.

risks.title: Increased competition on lifestyle models
risks.score_rationale: The success of models such as Samba or Gazelle is emphasized, but with strong competitive implications. The language is cautious. Trend is upward. The Competition category is directly linked to product differentiation.

risks.title: Growing regulation on sustainability
risks.score_rationale: The topic is regularly addressed (CSRD, EU Taxonomy), with technical and preparatory language. Trend is upward. The Regulation category is strategic for future compliance.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed within the Audit Committee, with technical language ("data privacy and information security"). Trend is stable. The Cybersecurity category is critical for operational continuity.

risks.title: Dependence on AI for product innovation
risks.score_rationale: AI is mentioned as both an opportunity and a risk, but with exploratory language. Trend is upward. The Technology category reflects an ongoing transformation.

risks.title: Major legal disputes
risks.score_rationale: The dispute with Kanye West is central, with strong language ("major legal disputes"). Trend is upward. The Litigation category has a direct impact on reputation and finances.
